summary.en: Korean Chromium-based browser. Linaro's catalog lists a native Arm64 build.
summary.zh-TW: 南韓以 Chromium 為基礎的瀏覽器。Linaro 目錄列有原生 Arm64 版本。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: The Linaro entry was last updated 2026-05-08, so the current version is unconfirmed.
caveats.zh-TW: Linaro 該筆資料最後更新於 2026-05-08，目前版本尚未確認。

caveats.en: Vendor page could not be read from this environment; the result rests on the Linaro catalog alone.
caveats.zh-TW: 此環境無法讀取原廠頁面，結果僅依據 Linaro 目錄。
